name: Chin-up
common_faults: partial ROM not reaching chin over bar
kipping when strict is the goal
no scapular engagement at the bottom

substitutions.note: pronated grip; less bicep emphasis; more lat dominant

contraindications: elbow tendinopathy aggravated by loaded supinated elbow flexion
resistance_profile: hardest at the bottom (dead hang to chin-over-bar); supinated grip increases bicep leverage

provenance.notes: Greater bicep brachii contribution than pronated pull-up due to supination. Generally easier than pull-up for most people due to bicep assistance. SFR heuristic.
